opportunities.name: Mantle hit echo
opportunities.objective: Explore whether repeated item on-hits improve Mantle recovery without inventing extra stance attacks.
opportunities.mechanic: W next two attacks heal with AP/health and gain lifesteal; awakened W doubles those healing attacks and supplies a larger AP/health/AD shield. Dusk and Dawn repeats on-hit effects, while Nashor adds a known attack packet. Visage improves self recovery, and each actual post-stance attack refunds 5% of Awaken cooldown.
opportunities.requiredState: Record awakened versus normal W, finite health and exactly two post-stance attacks.
opportunities.failure: W heal may not be repeated by the item; melee access and low offense can lose the fight.
opportunities.test: Count W heal packets, Dusk repetition and Awaken refund for exactly two attacks.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: A repeated on-hit packet is not another attack and cannot automatically double Awaken refund.

opportunities.name: Isolated claw storm hybrid
opportunities.objective: Use AP/AD hybrid attacks while isolating the awakened Q lightning target.
opportunities.mechanic: Q ordinary stance supports AD/flagged health physical on-hits, while awakened lightning retains an AP max-health ratio and bounces if other targets exist. R supplies AP magic pulses and an awakened following storm; Rageblade/Terminus support actual attacks with mixed damage and finite ramp. Choose one Awaken rather than grant both for free.
opportunities.requiredState: Isolated target, finite Rageblade/Terminus stacks and recorded chosen Awaken/cooldown.
opportunities.failure: Nearby units disperse lightning or defense sacrificed for attack items prevents two attacks.
opportunities.test: Compare isolated and multi-target Q lightning distribution, then separately test awakened R.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Unresolved awakened Q helper is not a known zero or a safely inferred full numerical coefficient.

ruledOut.reason: Passive Awaken has a finite cooldown reduced by actual attacks; Q/W/E/R empowered benefits cannot be freely combined.

unknowns: Awakened Q helper ee18a47b is unresolved and several AD/health formulas preserve statFormula=2. Healing/item inheritance and R special cooldown category require live checks.

builds.summary: Explore whether repeated item on-hits improve Mantle recovery without inventing extra stance attacks.
builds.goal: Explore whether repeated item on-hits improve Mantle recovery without inventing extra stance attacks.
builds.hypothesis: W next two attacks heal with AP/health and gain lifesteal; awakened W doubles those healing attacks and supplies a larger AP/health/AD shield. Dusk and Dawn repeats on-hit effects, while Nashor adds a known attack packet. Visage improves self recovery, and each actual post-stance attack refunds 5% of Awaken cooldown.
testPlan: Required state: Record awakened versus normal W, finite health and exactly two post-stance attacks.
Count W heal packets, Dusk repetition and Awaken refund for exactly two attacks.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: W heal may not be repeated by the item; melee access and low offense can lose the fight.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: A repeated on-hit packet is not another attack and cannot automatically double Awaken refund.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Dusk and Dawn, Nashor's Tooth, Riftmaker, Spirit Visage, Jak'Sho, The Protean, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

Mantle Stance: Udyr gains [45 / 65 / 85 / 105 / 125 / 145 + (0.02 / 0.023 / 0.026 / 0.029 / 0.032 / 0.035) × Stat(12) + (0.4) × AP + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] Shield for [4] seconds. Additionally, Udyr's next two Attacks gain [(0.15 / 0.16 / 0.17 / 0.18 / 0.19 / 0.2) × 100]% Life Steal and restore [(0.012) × Stat(12) + (0.08) × AP] Health.

Awaken: Gain [characterLevelInterpolation(20 → 150; raw flags preserved) + 45 / 65 / 85 / 105 / 125 / 145 + (0.65) × AP + (0.08) × Stat(12) + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] Shield, restore [(characterLevelInterpolation(20 → 150; raw flags preserved) + 45 / 65 / 85 / 105 / 125 / 145 + (0.65) × AP + (0.08) × Stat(12) + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (0.5)] Health over [4] seconds, and Udyr's next two Attacks instead have [(0.15 / 0.16 / 0.17 / 0.18 / 0.19 / 0.2) × 200]% Life Steal and restore [((0.012) × Stat(12) + (0.08) × AP) × (2)] Health.

Awakened Spirit: Udyr has four basic Abilities that swap between Stances. Udyr can Recast an Ability that is on Cooldown to gain its bonuses again with Ultimate benefits. ([(characterLevelBreakpoints(start=50, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -10.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -10.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -10.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])) × (1)] second Cooldown).

Monk Training: After using an Ability, Udyr's next two Attacks within [4] seconds gain [0.3] Attack Speed and refund [5]% of Awaken's Cooldown.
